import pandas as pd

payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'
beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'

# Read payments with header at row 4
df_pay = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
# Clean column names and strip whitespace
df_pay.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df_pay.columns]

# Read beneficiaries
df_ben = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)

# Trim whitespace from Beneficiary ID in both
df_pay['Beneficiary ID'] = df_pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
df_ben['Beneficiary ID'] = df_ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Normalize status: trim and lower
df_pay['Status_clean'] = df_pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

# Filter paid
df_paid = df_pay[df_pay['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()

# Exclude payment rows whose Beneficiary ID is absent from CSV
valid_ids = set(df_ben['Beneficiary ID'])
df_paid_valid = df_paid[df_paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)].copy()

# Distinct beneficiaries
distinct_count = df_paid_valid['Beneficiary ID'].nunique()
print("Distinct beneficiaries with paid payment and valid ID:", distinct_count)

# Also show count of rows
print("Paid rows:", len(df_paid))
print("Paid rows with valid ID:", len(df_paid_valid))

# For debugging, check any unmatched IDs
unmatched = df_paid[~df_paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)]['Beneficiary ID'].unique()
print("Unmatched IDs sample:", unmatched[:10])

import pandas as pd

payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'
beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'

df_pay = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
df_pay.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df_pay.columns]

df_ben = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)

# Clean
df_pay['Beneficiary ID'] = df_pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
df_ben['Beneficiary ID'] = df_ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Remove rows where Beneficiary ID is 'nan' or empty
df_pay = df_pay[~df_pay['Beneficiary ID'].isin(['nan', 'NaN', ''])]

df_pay['Status_clean'] = df_pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

df_paid = df_pay[df_pay['Status_clean'] == 'paid']

valid_ids = set(df_ben['Beneficiary ID'])

# Check duplicates in beneficiaries
dup_ben = df_ben['Beneficiary ID'].duplicated().sum()
print("Duplicate beneficiary IDs in CSV:", dup_ben)

# Merge
merged = df_paid.merge(df_ben[['Beneficiary ID']], on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
distinct = merged['Beneficiary ID'].nunique()
print("Distinct via merge:", distinct)

# Check counts
print("Total paid rows after cleaning:", len(df_paid))
print("Paid rows after inner join:", len(merged))
